_comment: Welcome kits — a starter package granted once per player per package version (sqlite ledger at server/state/welcome-kits.db). OFF by default. To use: add items to packages[].items (template = the item TemplateId, e.g. from data/admin/items.json; quality 0 = base), then set enabled:true. The scan-loop (started by the entrypoint when enabled) runs every scan_interval_secs (min 15) and grants the active_version package to online players who haven't received it. Bump active_version to re-grant everyone once. Grants route via give-item: online->RMQ, offline->DB, capacity-checked. Example item: {"template": "Water_1", "qty": 5, "quality": 0}.
